text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] org=org-982 high error-rate + request spike detected on /v1/generate (p50 latency 420ms, p95 1.8s, 5xx rate 6%) — paging sre_oncall :rotating_light:

alex: oncall here, seeing the spike. Is this isolated to org-982?

marta: looks like org-982 is causing sustained QPS ~280, their usual commit was 40. They're on Dedicated but bursted. Customer success pinged them already.

calvin: confirming traffic pattern: sudden fan-out from many short completions, lots of small prompts. KV cache hit rate dropped. stack traces show retries from client side.

jamie: CS says they spun up a batch job accidentally, possibly testing. They replied to CS thread "sorry, disabling in 2m" but might need an emergency throttle.

alex: +1 to emergency throttle. Suggest temporary org-level QPS cap to stop noisy neighbor. Propose: set org-982 qps=30 for 15m while CS confirms.

calvin: can do. Applying via admin tool now. Command: ```rbctl org-rate update --org org-982 --qps 30 --reason "emergency throttle - runaway job" --expires 15m```

incident-bot: command accepted, action queued. Change will be live in ~10s.

sre_oncall: I see throttling being applied, 429s spiking for org-982 as expected. Overall platform 5xx dropping back to baseline. :white_check_mark:

cs_lead: CS updated customer Slack: "We've applied a temporary throttle to avoid platform impact while you stop the job. Please confirm when stopped and we'll lift it." They asked for ETA ~5-10m.

alex: monitoring latency/backpressure. Can we also enable token-based soft-limits to avoid retries? Maybe set `retry-after` header guidance.

calvin: applied `Retry-After: 10` header on throttled responses for org-982 via proxy rule. Also pushed a short-lived routing rule to send org-982 to a lower-concurrency pool to limit resource contention.

jamie: CS says customer confirmed they've terminated the job. Requesting lift once we see sustained normal qps for 2m.

alex: agree. We'll keep throttle for another 2m and then ramp. Plan: qps 30 -> 80 -> remove. I'll coordinate the lift.

incident-bot: monitoring rule: alert if org-982 qps > 120 after lift or if 5xx > 1% platform-wide.

calvin: starting ramp: `rbctl org-rate update --org org-982 --qps 80 --reason "ramp after stop" --expires 5m`

sre_oncall: metrics look good. 5xx at 0.8%, latency back near normal. No collateral impact.

alex: ramp to normal. `rbctl org-rate update --org org-982 --qps 200 --reason "restore post-throttle"`

incident-bot: change accepted. Restored to committed QPS for org-982.

marta: follow-up: recommend we add an org-level safety policy: auto-throttle when sustained >5x baseline for >1m, with CS notification. Filing a tracking ticket.

jamie: CS to follow up with customer postmortem and recommended guardrails.

alex: post-incident notes: root cause = accidental batch job. Mitigation = temporary org throttle + routing to low-concurrency pool + Retry-After header. No data loss, customer side caused spike. Closing after postmortem. :lock:

incident-bot: Incident resolved by alex, calvin at 1956008210. Tags: rate-limiting, org-throttle, customer-impact.
